description: Implementation of PaymentTypeWriteService for creating, updating, and deleting payment types in the Fineract project, including data validation and exception handling.

classes.name: PaymentTypeWriteServiceImpl
classes.description: Service class for managing payment types, including creation, update, and deletion with cache management and data validation.

methods.name: createPaymentType
methods.description: Creates a new payment type after validating input data and saving it to the repository.

methods.name: updatePaymentType
methods.description: Updates an existing payment type with new data if changes are detected.

methods.name: deletePaymentType
methods.description: Deletes a payment type, handling data integrity issues if present.

methods.name: handleDataIntegrityIssues
methods.description: Handles specific data integrity violations during deletion, throwing appropriate exceptions.
